Blades point outward safely, no contact wounds. Boy rides standing on ONE large Wheel of Dharma [goho-doji-c03], a solid antique bronze wheel with eight plain spokes, no lettering. No horns, wings, fangs or adult body.

SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; very low close camera beneath wheel; guardian face, sword collar, sword and noose clearly distinct, wheel solid and dominant; no cosmic giant child.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant amber fire or low moon, deep walnut shadows, hard rim light; ordinary dust, rain or spray as appropriate.
SURFACE: tactile natural hair, coarse cloth, wet scales, skin, wood or stone; premium painterly brushwork, no plastic.
SETTING: Air above a Japanese Buddhist temple approach, uninscribed wooden roofs [goho-doji-c01,goho-doji-c03].
MOOD: imposing and active, never cute, calm or decorative. Helpful and living sacred figures remain benevolent, dignified and awe-inspiring.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, pseudoletters, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, eyes, limbs or fingers; no film, game, anime or comic designs; fully opaque clothing on humanoids; no nudity, blood or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, floating runes or energy ribbons.
